_comment: OTA manifest for ESP32C3 Cards WiFi firmware. Place this file in the repo root and commit/push. The ESP32 checks this raw URL when the host triggers an update.
_usage: When you release a new version: 1) Tag a release (e.g. v1.7.2). 2) Build and attach firmware.bin to the release. 3) Update the version/url below and push to main.
